description: Places public addresses: each address's country, coordinates, autonomous system and operator. One provider is active at a time. The core decides which addresses need placing -- never a non-public one -- stores the answers in geo_asn and places every address again when the active provider or its build changes.

functions.description: Called at start and after every refresh: whether a dataset is held, and its build.
functions.name: status

functions.description: Called at refresh_interval_geoip_seconds: acquire or update the dataset.
functions.name: refresh

functions.description: Called at poll_interval_geo_lookup_seconds with a batch of public addresses.
functions.name: lookup

fields.description: The `result` record; its probe is a word naming what the last refresh found.
fields.name: result

fields.description: Whether a dataset is held and answers lookups.
fields.name: ready

fields.description: The build of the dataset held, which every answer is recorded against.
fields.name: build

fields.description: Why the refresh failed, when it did.
fields.name: error

fields.description: The build the answers come from.
fields.name: build

fields.description: One `geolocation` record per address asked about.
fields.name: answers

records.description: What the dataset says about one address.
